punchline: A Marine who wouldn't use a water slide as a kid calmly swam out of another jumper's parachute in mid-air.
thirty_sec: Mia Blundetto hates falling, but her Marine Corps job requires jump school. No notebooks allowed. For weeks she practises the landing roll, first in a gravel pit, then from higher and higher platforms. On her third real jump she drops onto another soldier's canopy and just swims out. The authors of Make It Stick say learning consolidates over hours and days, sleep seems to help, so space your practice.
key_contrast: weeks of drills, calm in the air
